purpose: Service review for WUP2025 rank 406 Sendai (city code 5593); source registry evidence and safe anonymous full-polygon access status.
registryBasis: Sendai City publishes a tax-reference chibanzu map and a CC BY open-data shape archive through G空間情報センター. The 2026-07-13 land-area archive contains a 645,056-record Polygon shapefile in JGD2011 / Japan Plane Rectangular CS X (EPSG:6678). Geometry-only extraction confirms a polygon containing the exact WUP 2025 rank-406 point and two nearby polygons. The city warns that the reference map is not proof of parcel boundaries, exact position/shape, or rights, is unsuitable for measurement, and has unprepared areas.

officialSources.observation: City page says the tax-reference map is based on cadastral/public maps, shows land locations, town names and lot numbers, offers a shape-format open-data download and a public web-map search; its disclaimers exclude proof of boundaries, exact position/shape or rights and say some areas are not prepared.

Public dataset catalogue lists the Sendai lot-map package. Its land-area archive was downloaded anonymously (HTTP 200, 41,289,785 bytes); only geometry files were extracted after inspecting DBF schema descriptors without reading any row values.

Anonymous CKAN metadata lists the land-area archive as 7z, 41,289,785 bytes, updated 2026-07-13. Full archive temporary download succeeded; the directory lists tochi.dbf, .prj, .shp, and .shx. DBF header and field descriptors only were read; no row values were read.
Anonymous homepage lists map ID 299 as “地番図（参考図）”, describes it as a reference map of land locations/town names/lot numbers, and marks guest AuthLevel 0.
Municipal FAQ confirms anyone may view the reference lot map and that a GIS-use shapefile is published; the map remains a tax reference rather than an authoritative rights/boundary source.

accessReview.reason: Static WAGMap review found the anonymous geometry endpoint requires a feature ID, while its list route would expose labels and coordinates and its coordinate-identify route returns attributes; neither was called. Separately, the official CC BY land-area archive was downloaded anonymously, its DBF header/field descriptors were inspected without reading any row values, and only SHP/SHX/PRJ were extracted. The geometry sample is tied to 1-based SHP record numbers only; DBF attributes and their values were not joined or retained. This research sample does not enable a production runtime source.
accessReview.nativeIdsUsed: 1-based SHP record numbers only; DBF not joined

sampleDisposition: Retained three complete Polygon geometries from public SHP records 309577, 303660, and 644804 in samples/sendai-chibanzu-wup406.geojson; record 309577 contains the exact WUP point. Only DBF header/schema descriptors were inspected; no DBF record values were read or joined.
remainingUncertainty: Native parcel labels/IDs and DBF attribute values were intentionally not read. The sample uses 1-based SHP record numbers from the archive snapshot. Archive currency is as listed in public CKAN metadata (updated 2026-07-13); area coverage beyond the retained nearby sample is not assessed. The city’s tax-reference disclaimers and unprepared areas limit positional/legal use.

geometryRoute.responseContract: Client parses JsonResult.fp coordinate arrays and fpt part/ring markers; no geometry call performed.

featureListRoute.responseContract: Client reads JsonResult.infos[].name, fid, x, y; no field-selection/ID-only parameter exposed.

viewerClientInspection.reason: No geometry-by-ID call was made because the inspected client supplied no safe live feature-ID selector. The static archive was subsequently fetched successfully and SHP/SHX/PRJ extracted selectively; solid compression is not an access blocker.

rootAssessment: Three complete polygons were verified by selective geometry-only extraction from the official public 2026-07-13 archive; one contains the exact ranked WUP point. Original native EPSG:6678 rings pass root GEOS validity and nonduplicate checks. No anonymous live viewport, complete paging, fresh exact parcel-ID or footprint/binding contract has been qualified; retained identities are archive-snapshot SHP record numbers. The tax-reference and accuracy notices are informational and are not the runtime gate.
